parameter.name: CORR_ENTRIES
parameter.what: issue #257: entries in the per-frame Q1.15 cutoff-correction table indexed by the host k register over res 1..2. 0 disables the correction.

objective.name: mean-offset travel on the select grid
objective.why: issue #237's defect itself: how far the across-cutoff mean offset moves across the resonance knob.

range_basis: 0 is the filter that ships; 2 is a straight line in res (the fit residual's degree-1 case); 33 is a 5-bit index, finer than the offset's own curvature needs and 528 ROM bits. Powers of two plus the guard entry because the read is a shift.
Committed in docs/res-tuning/plan.json (commit dcbc2e1) before any point was measured.

decision_rule.why: pre-registered: two travels are distinguishable only beyond ~2 cents (estimator qualified to 1 c, a travel is a difference of two means), which is 20-40 % of the 5-10 c travels the larger tables were expected to reach.

evidence.instrument: model/res_tuning.py ring_frequency on reference_rigs.OurLadder's free ring; table entries fitted per knot on the fit grid (cutoffs 100..6400 Hz at the knot resonances), never on the select or validate grid.

verdict.summary: 104.8 c disabled, 30.0 c for a straight line, 12.1 c for three entries, then 4.3 / 3.9 / 2.3 / 1.3 c. The pre-registered selection rule (smallest table in the best run) picks 33. Read the steps above 5 entries with the rule's own caveat: 5 -> 33 entries buys 3 cents of travel, about the estimator-granularity argument the 25 % rule was derived from, and a 9-entry table (144 ROM bits instead of 528) gives 3.9 c.

limits: Model-level only: the parameter lives in model/res_tuning.py's candidate, not yet in rtl-sketch/voice_dp.v or the numeric contract (spec/decision-records/0024). The gate checks the candidate's value, which is what a later RTL change must carry.

Measured on the SELECT grid (7 cutoffs 100..6400 Hz x 7 resonances 1.02..2.00). The selected candidate was then validated once on the untouched grid in docs/res-tuning/validation.txt; that grid had no part in this choice.

The pre-registered PREDICTION FAILED and is deliberately not carried as a prediction block: docs/res-tuning/plan.json predicted runs [[0], [2], [3], [5, 9, 17, 33]]; the relative 25 % rule separates 17 and 33 from 5-9 because at 1-4 cents a relative tolerance is finer than the absolute granularity it was derived from. The record is therefore ungrounded on its shape, and says so.

The objective is a mean over cutoffs; the per-cutoff travel at the low endpoint is dominated by the integer-Hz corrected cutoff (~57 c per Hz at 30 Hz), which no table size changes. See validation.txt.
